modelEvidenceCorrections: The model treated the exact Phase 1B close as not publicly disclosed. The January 30, 2024 FERC notice states that the transaction closed on December 22, 2023.
The model used October 26, 2022 as the Phase 1A entry date because that is the public release date. The FERC filing states that the legal close occurred on October 20, 2022.

The model said Axium's Phase 1B share within the joint 50% acquisition was not publicly disclosed. FERC identifies Axium ES Holdings as the direct holder of the 50% voting interest and AxInfra US LP as owning 92.26% of its upstream co-invest holding company. The proposal preserves these disclosed layers without calculating a synthetic combined-company percentage.

The FederalRegister model URL redirects to a generic unblock page under direct HTTP verification and is excluded from the proposal; the FERC eLibrary landing page and downloaded filing are used instead.
The manager's transaction-era nameplate figures differ from its current portfolio's operating figures. Both are date-qualified rather than overwritten or conflated.
exitSearchConclusion: No Axium sale, signed pending exit, ownership transfer or later divestiture of either phase or the combined holding was identified through 2026-08-18. Axium's live portfolio page continues to list the combined holding as operating.
